copy.en:
Polyester Lining, Organized Packing
Polyester lining, two compartments, and X-shaped straps keep packing organized on the move.
Separate wet-dry pocket for damp clothing
Three-position handle suits different user heights
copy.zh:
涤纶内衬，收纳更有序
双区分隔搭配X型固定带，让途中衣物保持整齐。
干湿分离袋，湿衣物单独收纳
三档拉杆，适配不同身高
copy.de:
Polyesterfutter für geordnetes Packen
Polyesterfutter, zwei Fächer und X-förmige Gurte halten Ihr Gepäck unterwegs übersichtlich.
Nass-Trocken-Fach für feuchte Kleidung
Griff mit drei Positionen für verschiedene Körpergrößen
copy.fr:
Doublure polyester, rangement ordonné
La doublure polyester, les deux compartiments et les sangles en X organisent vos affaires en déplacement.
Poche séparée pour vêtements humides
Poignée à trois positions pour différentes tailles
copy.it:
Fodera in poliestere, ordine in valigia
Fodera in poliestere, due scomparti e cinghie a X tengono gli articoli organizzati durante il viaggio.
Tasca separata per capi umidi
Manico a tre posizioni per diverse altezze
copy.es:
Forro de poliéster, equipaje ordenado
El forro de poliéster, los dos compartimentos y las correas en X mantienen todo organizado durante el viaje.
Bolsillo separado para prendas húmedas
Asa de tres posiciones para distintas alturas

design_brief_zh: 主卖点为涤纶材质内衬，围绕“行李更易分类、固定和保持干爽”建立单一视觉故事；证据仅使用已提供的涤纶内衬、双区分隔、X型固定带和干湿分离袋，并以三档拉杆作为指定的身高适配辅助卖点。PC画布1464×600：左侧产品区[x,y,w,h]=[0.05,0.08,0.46,0.84]，展示打开的旅行箱，清晰看到涤纶内衬、双区结构、X型固定带和干湿分离袋；拉杆在旁边以三个不同高度位置呈现，表达三档调节。右侧文案区[x,y,w,h]=[0.57,0.1,0.38,0.8]，按从上到下阅读：第1行标题，第2行支持说明，第3行干湿分离袋细节，第4行三档拉杆细节；德语预留约20%横向扩展空间。移动端1200×900：上方产品与实际整理场景区[x,y,w,h]=[0.08,0.05,0.84,0.53]，下方文案区[x,y,w,h]=[0.05,0.64,0.9,0.31]，保持同样的标题→说明→两个细节阅读顺序，并将三档拉杆以三个高度的简洁视觉对照置于上方场景边缘。产品采用与实物一致的铝合金框架、竖条纹硬壳和中性色外观，不新增材质或结构；使用欧洲现代旅行摄影、低饱和中性色和柔和自然侧光，打开箱体内部获得清晰但不夸张的阴影层次，突出纺织内衬纹理与分区。字体使用Arial、Helvetica或Amazon Ember风格无衬线字体，标题加粗，正文和细节保持高对比、短行距，数字“三档”优先清晰易读。
compliance_note_zh: 文案仅使用已提供的涤纶内衬、双区分隔、X型固定带、干湿分离袋和三档拉杆事实；不得添加防水、静音、承重、认证或绝对化耐用等未经证实的表述，画面不得出现竞品标识或虚构图标。
image_prompt_en: Create a premium European modern travel photograph for an Amazon A+ full-image module, with no rendered text, no logos, no badges, and no promotional graphics. PC composition at 1464x600: place an opened YWJ 13A travel suitcase on the left within approximately x=5%, y=8%, w=46%, h=84%; keep the right side from x=57% to 95% clear and uncluttered for later copy overlay. Show the supplied suitcase appearance consistently: vertical-striped hard shell, aluminium frame, neutral silver/gunmetal/black styling, and visible polyester interior lining. The open case must clearly show two interior compartments, X-shaped fixing straps, and a separate wet-dry pocket, using realistic packing with dry clothing in one area and a small damp garment isolated in the dedicated pocket. Beside or behind the suitcase, show the telescopic handle at three distinct height positions through a clean, realistic height-comparison visual, without labels or text. Use soft natural side light, low-saturation neutral colors, realistic textile and aluminium textures, and a refined European travel-photography aesthetic. Mobile composition at 1200x900: place the suitcase and height-adjustment usage scene in the upper region x=8%, y=5%, w=84%, h=53%, leaving the lower region x=5%, y=64%, w=90%, h=31% as a clean background for copy overlay. Preserve the visual hierarchy from interior organization to wet-dry separation and then three-position handle adjustment. Do not render any words, letters, numbers, labels, icons, or UI elements in the image.
